title: Oaty Drop Scones
description: Healthy blueberry drop scones made from whisked egg whites, rolled oats and fresh blueberries — a high-protein, gluten-free alternative to American pancakes.
steps: Whisk the egg whites gently by hand for a couple of minutes until they start to froth.
Pour in the oats and stir to combine. Add more egg white if too dry. Stir in three-quarters of the blueberries.
Heat a knob of butter in a large frying pan. Spoon the mix in 1cm-thick circles, fitting about three at a time.
Cook for 4–5 minutes until golden brown underneath, then flip and repeat.
Serve hot topped with the remaining blueberries.
notes: Each batch (6 drop scones) serves 2–3. Multiply as needed.
